person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and consistently uses close third person while rotating among ten focal characters. Numerous supplied event passages expose private thoughts through third-person forms, and authorized opening and interior excerpts independently show the same technique. The reverse chronology and multiple viewpoints therefore do not constitute alternation in narrative person. Generic “you” passages are aphoristic or free-indirect, while q03134’s isolated “I” is local speech/direct thought rather than a sustained first-person section. A few clipped quotes remain locally unattributable, but the explicit whole-book description and broad third-person prose evidence leave no material book-level uncertainty.
